date: "The Date"
output: html_document

  h1 { font-size: 2rem; }

```{r setup, include=TRUE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r saving_screenshots, echo=FALSE}
thedate <- Lmisc::date_current_file()

path.to.screenshots <- NULL # Add path to screenshots/images here

if(!is.null(path.to.screenshots)){
  all.images <- Lmisc::get_images_w_path(path.to.screenshots)
  images <- all.images[grep(pattern = thedate, x = all.images)]
}
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
knitr::include_graphics(images) # Show all screenshots/images
```
